title: Estimate the Percent of a Number

items.stem: Which of the following is the best estimate for 18% of 250 using benchmark percents?
A store has 320 items, and about 30% of them are on sale. Which estimate correctly shows how many items are on sale?
Select ALL the benchmark percents that are most useful for estimating 27% of a number.
Estimate 43% of 180 by using benchmark percents. Show or explain your work.
